notablePrerequisites:
Phyresis attached to Kediss.
Kediss does not have summoning sickness.Your life total is at least ten.

description:
Declare Kediss as an attacker, choosing to attack an opponent unable to block.
Before damage, cast Hatred for {3}{B}{B}, paying nine life and giving Kediss +9/+0 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Kediss, causing an opponent to get ten poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing each other opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to lethal infect damage.
